requirements.requirement: Nginx on node1 serves a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6500.
requirements.summary: A direct request to node1's IP at port 6500 returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK with an nginx Server header and response body. Nginx was also directly observed owning IPv4 and IPv6 listeners on port 6500.

overall_summary: The requested outcome is fully satisfied: nginx returned a successful response at node1:6500/. The system remained healthy, with only a minor hygiene concern from unnecessary port 80 listeners.
limitations: The HTTP probe originated on node1 using its managed IP rather than from a separate external client; off-host reachability was not independently exercised.

operational_hygiene.summary: No failed services or package inconsistency were observed after execution. A minor deduction applies because installing and enabling the default configuration also caused nginx to bind port 80 on all IPv4 and IPv6 interfaces, which was not required by the task; evidence does not show that firewalld exposes port 80.
